responsibility: Collects analyzer-wide utility routines that do not belong to a narrower component. In this file the analyzer reconstructs better tree expressions for diagnostics from SSA temporaries and def-stmts, works around missing statement locations, recognizes special and standard-library calls such as setjmp/longjmp, provides user-facing function names for messages, and builds formatted label_text objects used by path events and warnings.
same_name_distinction: Contains the out-of-line analyzer utility code itself, such as diagnostic tree reconstruction, call-name recognition helpers, setjmp/longjmp detection, and label_text formatting. Within the same-name group, this is the implementation file, not the shared declarations or option table.
